name: context-capsule
description: Write a resume-ready capsule of your session, then /clear or auto-compact and pick up exactly where you left off. Manual-trigger refresh: PreCompact nudge, SessionStart pointer on clear and compact, /capsule, /refresh and /resume. Zero dependencies, no network.

capsuleDir.title: Capsule directory
capsuleDir.description: Folder where capsules are written and read. Relative paths resolve against the project. Empty: <project>/.claude/capsules/.

maxAgeDays.title: Stale limit (days)
maxAgeDays.description: Capsules older than this are refused at resume instead of loaded.
